Plan and FROZEN budgets, recorded 2026-10-01 before any lattice-inverse evaluation at fsLR vertices. Worktree /private/tmp/scalafim-fslr-inverse-20261001, branch work/fslr-lattice-inverse-20261001, base c6030454 (reviewed reconcile candidate, unmerged). Local commits only; no push or merge.

Design. No new solver and no atlas edge. surface already depends on transform, so the route estimates the inverse of its own digest-bound DeclaredPointMap through scalafim.transform WorldTransform.Mapped.materialize + invertNumerically (reframe4s NumericalInversion). That produces PushAvailability.Estimated(QualifiedInverse), bound by identity to the exact pullback it was qualified against. Admission is limited to the stage pattern [one displacement, then affines]. For that pattern, materializing the composite on the displacement field's own lattice is exact, because trilinear interpolation commutes with affines. Any other stage order is refused as LatticeInverseUnsupported. A new typed PointMapUse.LatticeInverse carries lattice id/shape/affine, policy settings and gates, achieved coverage, forward/reverse residual summaries and status counts. Route disclosure and the bridge display name it as a numerical lattice inverse with Confidence Approximate. PointMapUse.Inverse (exact pointwise) keeps returning PointwiseInverseUnavailable.

Real lattice and policy, declared now: the full TemplateFlow MNI152NLin6Asym res-01 grid (182x218x182, 1 mm, first voxel (-91,-126,-72); the same lattice as the atlas MniTemplateBridge estimate). Policy is the pre-existing MniTemplateBridge.defaultInversionPolicy values: coverage >= 0.99, max <= 0.5 mm, p99 <= 0.05 mm, interior margin 1, iterations <= 100, tolerance 1e-8, divergence ratio 4.

FROZEN vertex budgets (JVM, SCALAFIM_REQUIRE_REAL_ASSETS=1):
B1 placement vs the independent SimpleITK 2.5.6 fixed-point oracle (fixture fslr-inverse-oracle.json.gz, 2500 vertices per hemisphere): max |lattice - oracle| <= 0.05 mm and p99 <= 0.02 mm per hemisphere.
B2 availability: zero BridgeUnavailable among oracle vertices.
B3 voxel identity on the 2009c res-01 (1 mm) and res-02 (2 mm) source grids: every nearest-voxel disagreement between lattice and oracle placements must be explained. On each disagreeing axis, the oracle's continuous index must lie within that vertex's placement error of the half-integer boundary. 100% must be explained; counts are reported.
B4 all 64,984 vertices: round trip through the exact declared composite (PointMap.forward, not the materialized field), |forward(lattice(v)) - v| <= 0.05 mm, and every vertex placed.
B5 medial wall vertex-exact and display-geometry identity of mapped values preserved.
B6 cost recorded, with a gate of estimation + route preparation <= 300 s on JVM. Scala.js is covered by shared synthetic tests (analytic translation/affine inverses, refusals, gate failure with evidence), plus FullOpt where the route runs.
Out of scope: a digest-bound cached estimate (noted for follow-up), PLS consumer work, publication or merge.
